definition.proposition: At 200M tokens of code-py-v2, the assembled recipe A2s (GDN hybrid, shared core of 6 blocks x 2 passes with fixed r and full backprop, ternary core with full-precision prelude/coda/inject, contractive injection) beats the naive full fusion E27 by about 17% in clean80 bpc while using about 10% more training compute (3.79e16 vs 3.41-3.43e16 FLOPs per run).

scope.dataset: code-py-v2, clean80 doc-level bpc (v1 val, K9 overlap < 0.8)

definition.refutation_criteria: REFUTED if a replication on fresh seeds or a longer horizon (SQ380) puts the paired 95% CI of A2s - E27 at or above -5%
